_comment: v1.12.1 - the second De Bello Civili batch: Book II (6), which closes it at its allocation. Three from the siege of Massilia (the musculus, the broken truce, the surrender) and three from Curio in Africa (the loyalty test, the fatal error, the death). All six are whole chapters. Source defect: II.10 prints `diluere posset Coria autem` with no stop between the sentences.
